_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored - NEVER commit it.
_endpoint_help: The undocumented internal URL claude.ai calls to render Plan usage limits. Capture it from DevTools > Network, then paste here. Use {orgId} as a placeholder and it will be substituted.
_fieldMap_help: Maps the endpoint's JSON shape onto the widget's three metrics. 'pct' and 'resets_at' are dot/bracket paths into the response (e.g. 'five_hour.utilization' or 'limits[0].pct'). A bracket may also be a filter, 'limits[scope.model.display_name=Fable].percent', which finds the first array element whose nested field matches - use this instead of a fixed index for arrays whose order isn't guaranteed. 'scale' multiplies the raw value (use 100 if the API returns 0.0-1.0, use 1 if it already returns 0-100). 'invert' converts a REMAINING value into a USED percentage. Run 'node poller/probe.mjs' to dump the real response and get suggested paths.
